steps.text: 2. The system computes the figures for the last 7 days (default): tours pending review (Pending review, AI Warning, total), average review time (hours), tours reported in the period, tours with open reports, top 5 authors, Admin action count by type; the client shows the figure tiles (linking to the UC#19 / UC#20 queues) and a horizontal bar chart of actions. A1, A3, E1, E2.

exceptions.text: E1. No data yet → the figures are 0 and "No data yet" is shown; empty log → "No actions yet" / "No matching actions".
E2. Invalid period (from date not before to date, over 366 days, invalid format) → 400; the client reports the error before calling the API.

steps.text: 4. The system returns the newest log rows first (20 per page): time, action, target (tour or account, with a link), acting Admin, reason. E6.

exceptions.text: E6. An account.moderated event with an invalid format or a write error → only logged and acked; a redelivered event adds no row.

steps.text: 5. The Admin filters by action type, target, administrator ID and date range, then taps "Filter". A2, E4, E5.

exceptions.text: E4. No valid token → 401; not an Admin → 403.
E5. Calls to edit / delete data → 405 "View only; this data cannot be edited or deleted".

steps.text: 6. The system shows the matching rows, paginated. E3.

exceptions.text: E3. Invalid filter or a log row ID that is not a UUID → 400; the log row does not exist → 404 "Log record not found".

steps: A1. Change the period: "7 days", "30 days" or "Custom" (From date, To date, "Apply"); the system recomputes the figures.
A3. Go on from the dashboard: pick a top contributor to open the account page (UC#21), pick the pending / reports tile to open the UC#19 / UC#20 queue.
A2. View a log row's details: the system shows the full log row, including the attached data.
